notes: Account summary: mid-market PMF analytics SaaS company — heavy product telemetry, user-facing 'help assistant' in-app, internal search and summarization for onboarding docs.
Initial engagement: Joined Redwood hosted API trial (Dec 2024) to validate latency and cost for client-facing chat and admin search endpoints.
Customer quote from 2024-12-04 call: "If we can hit p95 < 300ms for short chat completions and get predictable per-token economics, we can consolidate vendors."
Primary drivers: lower per-token cost at scale, predictable latency, VPC + audit logs for SOC2 II, and ability to reserve capacity for predictable peak traffic windows.
Security: internal compliance team insists on KMS integration + audit log retention 1 year; SSO/SAML mandatory for admin console; data residency preference for US-only storage.
Decision process: Product + Infra + Security + Finance involved. Procurement target: Q1 2025 (forecast 2025-03).

POC notes: used hosted_api w/ gpt-compatible open model in Redwood catalog. Ran a 2-week trial with simulated peak traffic (holiday promo) and real user queries. Observed higher token mix for summarize calls than expected.
Pricing sensitivity: CFO flagged that committed spend needs guaranteed baseline and ability to burst to additional capacity at capped premium.
Quote from engineering lead on demo: "Batching and KV cache helped average latency, but concurrency spikes still need smoothing — interested in pre-warmed Dedicated pools."
Competitive check: they've run tests vs OpenAI endpoints and an in-house trimmed model. Redwood outperformed on p95 cost and had better routing features they liked.
Links shared: security FAQ + SOC2 docs in drive; demo recording (ff_20250108_prod_demo).

workload_summary: Primary workloads: live in-app chat (support-agent), document search (embeddings + rerank), nightly bulk summarization jobs (batch).

Token profile (observed during hosted trial): avg tokens per chat request = 420 total (prompt 200 / response 220), avg tokens per summarization job = 2.8k, embedding request = 1.6k tokens per doc batch call.
Traffic shape (trial week): baseline QPS ~0.9, 95th percentile QPS bursts to 18 QPS during product release; baseline concurrency ~6, peak concurrency recorded 46.
Streaming usage: ~22% of chat sessions use streaming responses; rest are non-streamed completions.
Desired SLAs: p95 latency target for chat completions < 300ms (token streaming allowed), p99 < 800ms for non-streaming admin queries.
traffic_forecast: Baseline forecast (next 12 months): 3x growth in MAU -> expected baseline QPS move from 0.9 to 2.7, with peak promotional QPS up to 55 under forecasted load.
Concurrency forecast: baseline concurrency grows from 6 to ~18, peak concurrency estimate 150 during large feature rollouts.
Token volume forecast: current monthly token consumption (trial extrapolated) ~150M tokens; 12-month forecast 450M-1.2B tokens depending on uptake of summarized reporting features.
Monthly seasonality: weekly spikes on Tuesday product digest; quarterly spikes near customer billing cycles.
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: Initial Dedicated footprint recommendation: 2 x A100-class GPUs equivalent in dedicated pool with autoscale policy to add +1 node above baseline for bursts; justify reserve to meet p95 <300ms for chat at forecasted baseline.
Batching config: conservative batch window 20ms for chat path, larger windows for summarization/embedding offline pipelines. Enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts to reduce per-token compute.
Routing/fallback: primary routing to Dedicated US-west; fallback to hosted fleet in other regions. Canary policy: 5% traffic shift for first 48 hours then 25% if no regressions.
Quantization guidance: try int8 for summarization model variants to cut cost for bulk jobs; keep float16 for low-latency chat models initially.
Estimated committed monthly spend band for Recommended config: $8k-$18k (depends on reserved term and token mix). Need to validate against finance ARR constraints.
POC goals for Dedicated evaluation: demonstrate sustained p95 < 300ms for chat at 3x baseline, validate autoscale add/remove within 90s, cost delta vs hosted API within 20%.
poC_success_criteria: Latency: sustained p95 < 300ms under simulated 3x baseline QPS
Reliability: zero critical errors and <0.1% request failures over 72h soak
Scaling: autoscale adds capacity to keep p95 under threshold within 90s of surge
Cost: projected per-token cost reduction >=15% vs hosted run-rate at projected volumes
Security: KMS integration validated and audit logging visible to customer security console
